subject: MAP: onboarding corridor & sample governance for RetailTech pilot
messages:
From: Lucas Martin <lucas.martin@retailtech.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, acme-legal@retailtech.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot MAP & sample exchange — RetailTech <> Redwood

David / Marissa —

Thanks for the demo last week. RetailTech is ready to run the 4-week pilot but legal needs a concise MAP and a clear list of what you need from us to start (samples, test cases, prompt packs) and how we may use the artifacts. Key asks from our side:

- We need an explicit acceptance gate for the evaluation (what constitutes pass/fail).
- Usage constraints: confirm whether samples stay ephemeral or can be cached/retained.
- Timeline: target kickoff June 21, acceptance window July 19.

Can you send a MAP with milestones + an inventory of requested artifacts and a short template we can share with our procurement/legal? If possible please call out any data handling guarantees (ephemeral access, destruction timeline).

Lucas
VP, Product
RetailTech
(attachment: pilot-overview.pdf)

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lucas Martin <lucas.martin@retailtech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP & sample exchange — RetailTech <> Redwood

Lucas — thanks, and great to hear the team is ready.

High level we can do exactly what you describe. I attached a concise MAP spreadsheet (RetailTech_MAP_v1.xlsx) that maps milestones to owners, deliverables, and acceptance criteria. Quick summary here:

- Kickoff (week of Jun 21): handoff of a 500-document sample corpus + a 20-case prompt pack.
- Staging/QA (week 2): Redwood runs closed evaluation with agreed testcases; weekly syncs.
- Acceptance (week 4): evaluation pass = >= 85% on priority metrics OR product-team signoff on qualitative regressions.

We will treat the sample corpus as ephemeral by default: cached only in a secure staging environment, destroyed on successful close or 30 days after pilot end unless you request retention. If you need stricter controls (air-gapped or on-prem retrieval), we can add that to the MAP.

Attachments: RetailTech_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP + milestone table), promptpack_sample_readme.md (format + prohibited usage), SLA-terms_redline.pdf (prelim for procurement).

Next steps:
- Please confirm kickoff date (Jun 21) and the contact for legal/procurement who will own the SLA redlines.
- Ben will follow up on DocuSign and procurement timing; Marissa will coordinate sample ingestion format.

Thanks — I’ll be on the sync Wednesday if you want to walk the MAP.

– David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
(attachment: RetailTech_MAP_v1.xlsx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lucas Martin <lucas.martin@retailtech.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP & sample exchange — RetailTech <> Redwood

Lucas — quick technical note on the prompt pack and testcases so procurement knows what to expect:  

- Prompt pack: we prefer markdown-encoded templates + a README (see promptpack_sample_readme.md). Include expected label format and a small acceptance set (20 cases) for early smoke tests.
- Ingestion: S3-compatible bundle, max 2GB for initial sample. SHA256 checksum required for tamper-proofing.
- Access model: ephemeral staging tokens scoped to the pilot. KV-cache will be disabled for any prompts marked "sensitive" in the README.

If RetailTech needs the files encrypted with your KMS key, we can accept an encrypted bundle and run ingestion in a private tenant. Let us know the preference.

Marissa
Head of Eval Programs
Redwood Inference
(attachment: promptpack_sample_readme.md)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lucas Martin <lucas.martin@retailtech.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: acme-legal@retailtech.com, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP & sample exchange — RetailTech <> Redwood

Lucas / legal —

Looping in procurement next steps and a minimal acceptance checklist so legal sees a concrete closure path:

Procurement checklist (to close pilot agreement)
- Sign MAP (attached spreadsheet) with milestone owners and dates.
- Agree SLA redlines (we attached a starting redline, SLA-terms_redline.pdf).
- Confirm artifact handling: ephemeral staging + destruction timeline (default = 30 days post-pilot).
- DocuSign: I will send a 1-page statement of work and the MAP to the RetailTech procurement contact once legal confirms redline items.

Proposed timeline
- Jun 14: Legal comments back on SLA redline
- Jun 16: DocuSign sent for MAP + SOW
- Jun 21: Kickoff + sample upload window opens
- Jul 19: Acceptance window closes

If that timeline works for you, please confirm who will be the signer on your side and whether your procurement needs a PO first (we can accept a PO or proceed on DocuSign and invoice after execution).

Ben Carter
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
(attachment: SLA-terms_redline.pdf)
